rows.en: (Now then, what should I do for fun today...)

Oh, Michel.
You out shopping or something?

Yeah, a part-time job is sending me to the
artificial island, so I came to pick up a swimsuit
and whatever else I might need.

Though I'd rather hit the beach on my own time
to have fun, not for work.

Have fun? Come on, all you'd do
is hit on girls anyway, right?
Obviously.

Well, I'm done with my shopping for now,
so I'll head home.
Yeah, see ya.
(Geez, Michel never changes.)
(Now then, what should I do for fun today...)

Oh, Michel-kun.
Are you out shopping or something?

Have fun? Come on, all you'd do
is hit on girls anyway, right?
Okay, see you.
rows.notes: x4: also the player's goodbye to Sheryl (nml_she_023) and to Ranka (Valentine scene).

rows.en: (Geez, Michel-kun never changes.)

(Can't wait for Sheryl's concert...
I'll actually get to meet the Galactic Fairy!)

What's up, \p?
What's with that goofy grin?

Oh, Michel.
When I think about meeting the Galactic Fairy,
I just can't stop grinning...

I get that you're excited, but don't get
carried away and screw up during the show.
rows.notes: honban: the actual performance; the player takes part in Sheryl's concert (Michel mentions the backup dancers).

rows.en: Yeah, I know.
Well, as long as you do...

Now then, I'd better work out my pickup lines
for those lovely backup-dancer ladies while I can.

(Even at a big show like this,
Michel doesn't change one bit...)

(I can't wait for Sheryl's concert...
I'll actually get to meet the Galactic Fairy!)

Oh, Michel-kun.
When I think about meeting the Galactic Fairy,
I just can't stop grinning...

(Even at a big show like this,
Michel-kun doesn't change one bit...)

(We finally found it...
a new planet we can live on...)

(I wonder what's waiting for us
on that new planet...
...I can't help feeling a little uneasy.)

Yo, \p.
What's with that face?

Well, I'm excited to see what's on the new planet,
but I'm a little uneasy too...

Don't worry so much.
Whatever happens, happens.

All that's happened is they found a new planet.
I think you should just go on like usual.

So with that, I think I'll go enjoy some tea
with the lovely ladies, like usual.
Heh, that's so like you, Michel.

(Yeah, Michel's right.
I should just go on like usual.)

(We finally found it...
a new planet we can live on...)

(I wonder what's waiting for us
on that new planet...
...I can't help feeling a little uneasy.)
Hehe, that's so like you, Michel-kun.

(Yeah, Michel-kun's right.
I should just go on like usual.)

(I came to the convenience store for a late-night
snack, but is there anything else I need?)

What are you doing out at this hour,
\p?

Oh, Michel.
I just came to buy a late-night snack.
What about you, Michel?

Oh, nothing much. I had a little errand
to run, and I'm on my way back.
Huh~ So what was the errand?

Whoa there, prying that far is a little uncool,
don't you think?
Huh? Uncool?
S-See ya...

(What on earth was Michel's errand?
Hmm, now I'm curious...)

Oh, Michel-kun.
I just came to buy a late-night snack.
What about you, Michel-kun?
S-See you...

(What on earth was Michel-kun's errand?
Hmm, now I'm curious...)
(I never imagined it would be this bad...)
(Oh, Michel's here too...)
Damn it! How did it come to this...

Fighting and dying should be the soldiers'
job alone, damn it! Why... Why...!
Oh, \p, you were here...

...Sorry.
That was pathetic of me to let you see.
Come on, it wasn't pathetic...

I'm fine now.
...I won't let them do as they please anymore!

(That Michel...
He's so wound up. Is he really going to be okay...?)
(Oh, Michel-kun's here too...)

(Michel-kun...
He's so wound up. Is he really going to be okay...?)

uncertain: c18054: 'tatakau no mo shinu no mo heitai dake de juubun daro' rendered 'Fighting and dying should be the soldiers' job alone, damn it!'; 'damn it' carries the rough 'daro' and Michel's anger (civilians died in the attack).
c18018/c18021: read as the player taking part in Sheryl's concert (Michel mentions backup dancers); 'honban' = the show.
